notes: The file 'avg152T1_LR_nifti2.nii.gz' is a NIfTI-2 conversion of the MNI152 ('avg152T1') 1mm T1-weighted average brain template. The MNI152 template originates from the Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) / ICBM project and is widely redistributed (e.g., as part of FSL and SPM) for non-commercial research use. The NIfTI-2 variant distributed here is a derived conversion prepared for testing the NIfTI-2 reader.
